items: 1 tsp anise (licorice) oil OR 1 tsp cinnamon oil
1 tsp black or red food color paste (no flavor)
2 tsp vanilla (added after cooking the caramel)

steps.title: Prepare the pan
steps.body: Lightly spray or butter a 9-inch square or 7×11-inch baking pan.

steps.title: Combine the ingredients
steps.body: In a heavy 4-quart saucepan, combine **1 can sweetened condensed milk**, **1½ cups light corn syrup**, **1 cup butter** and **¼ tsp salt**. For licorice or cinnamon caramels, add **2 cups sugar**. For vanilla (butter) caramels, add **1 cup white sugar** and **1 cup brown sugar** instead.

steps.title: Stir over heat
steps.body: Place over medium heat and stir with a wooden spoon until well-mixed.

steps.title: Cook to temperature
steps.body: Cook, stirring constantly, to around 243°F (depends on elevation, your thermometer, weather, etc.).

steps.title: Add the flavoring
steps.body: Remove from heat and stir in **1 tsp anise (licorice) oil** OR **1 tsp cinnamon oil**, and **1 tsp black or red food color paste** (no flavor), until well blended. For vanilla (butter) caramels, stir in **2 tsp vanilla** instead.

steps.title: Pour and cool
steps.body: Pour into the prepared pan. Allow to stand at room temperature several hours until completely cool.

steps.title: Cut and wrap
steps.body: Cut and wrap in cellophane or waxed paper pieces.
